items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Ben Webster nicknamed him Sweety Brown because of him being so nice and always so neat and everything

ctx.x: Sure, and Ben. Ben could get to him because, you know, Ben nicknamed him Sweety Brown because of him being so nice and always so neat and everything, and he kept this sponge in his pocket, Lawrence did, to wipe his face off all the time, you know, so that there would be no shine on his face. And Ben Webster nicknamed him Sweety Brown.
